writeup: Woot has the new Deco 79 gold metal scroll display easel, model 27388 and UPC 758647273881, for $39.99. It is a 26 by 30 by 67 inch iron stand with three scroll tiers and chain support. Home Depot sells the same 27388 stand, rebranded as Litton Lane, in stock at $88.50, Tractor Supply has the Harper and Willow version at $88.99, and Lamps Plus lists it at $98.99. That is 54 percent and about $48.51 below the lowest current market price. Quantity is only 3 left, with a limit of 10 per customer.
